correctness.rationale: Affine equivariance reduces all three-element row supports to two normal forms. Collinear determinants are exact pentagonal Vandermonde chord products with 125 lifts per residue triple. Noncollinear determinants expand into six fifth roots, and their squared moduli reduce exactly to integer pairs in Q(sqrt5). All 276 possible rooted nonzero frequency pairs are exhaustively evaluated in checker.py using standard-library integer arithmetic and an independent permutation expansion; translation multiplicities yield all 2300 unordered frequency triples. Exact optimizer orbits and global counts are checked. No unproved infinite extrapolation, floating tolerances or stale certificates.

value.rationale: The determinant volume D(E) is explicitly defined and motivated as a Fourier exponential-basis tightness invariant in arXiv:1904.04487, Definitions 3.9--3.10. This complete natural small-group classification determines its full positive-value spectrum, the exact five-unit squared-volume collinearity gap, and the two geometrically distinct noncollinear optimizer translation orbits. Rank-only results cannot answer these questions. It is mathematically motivated D-optimal harmonic interpolation rather than a selected arbitrary parameter slice; no downstream infinite theorem is asserted.
